title_en: ELITE VILLA FOR SALE IN MULLET
description_en: GAIA Residence is a complex of contemporary villas, consisting of 13 individual villas positioned in the area of ​​Mullet, in a space that offers privacy and tranquility in the middle of greenery. From an ecological point of view, the villas are designed towards energy consumption at level 0 through the installation of individual photovoltaic panels. In each of the villas, the necessary space has been designed for the installation of the elevator connecting the 3 levels of the villa.
